thread:
Alex (AE): quick sync — Acme PoV planning. Need an actionable runbook: success criteria, prompts/evals, timeline, SE coverage, and any security blockers. Can we sketch a 2-week plan and owners? :spiral_calendar:
Maya (SE): +1. I recommend: Week 0 prep (data access + test account), Week 1 prompt evals & baseline metrics, Week 2 integration + perf soak + handoff. Deliverables: eval report, integration checklist, cost/latency dashboard links.
Jordan (Security): callout: Acme needs KMS integration, data residency in eu-west, and answers to the standard infosec questionnaire. I can own the questionnaire responses but need a list of how PII flows.
Kyle (Eng): noted. For perf soak we can run on Dedicated or Hosted with reserved concurrency. Budget estimate: roughly 2 GPU-days on rtx-a6000 equiv for soak + a small staging cluster for integration. I can draft cost estimate.
Sam (SE-TPM): I'll coordinate SE coverage and customer ops. Proposed SE rota: Maya for prompts/evals, Kyle for infra support, Jordan for security Q&A, Alex for executive check-ins.
Alex (AE): sounds good. Success criteria suggestions: 1) baseline generation quality on 5 canonical prompts >= 0.85 pass rate, 2) 95th pct latency < 450ms for 512 tokens, 3) integration demo with sample app and docs. Add pricing acceptance threshold (TBD).
Maya (SE): I'll create the prompt set. Quick sketch of prompts (will refine):
```
- Summarize transaction notes to 3 bullets
- Extract entities: vendor, amount, date
- Re-write user query into normalized search query
- Rerank top-5 results by relevance score
```
I'll attach test inputs and expected outputs in the drive link after this thread.
Jordan (Security): For the questionnaire, quick answers: SOC2 status -> in progress (expected Q3), KMS -> customer-managed supported (we'll document key rotation), data-retention -> configurable. I'll need sample data flow diagram from SE.
Kyle (Eng): infra notes: if they want VPC Private deployment we need infra lead and 3 business days to spin preprod. Hosted path is faster (same-day smoke) but limited to our EU region. Which route is Acme leaning to?
Alex (AE): customer prefers private for compliance but open to hybrid for the run. I'll confirm and report back by EOD.
Sam (SE-TPM): blockers we should flag: security questionnaire turnaround, sample dataset availability, and SE time during demo week (avoid PTO).
Maya (SE): timeline proposal (dates are relative):
- Day 0: kickoff, credentials + test data
- Day 1-3: ingestion + baseline evals
- Day 4-6: prompt tuning + rerun evals
- Day 7-9: integration + end-to-end smoke
- Day 10-12: perf soak + monitoring dashboard
- Day 13-14: exec demo + handoff docs
I can own the eval report and prompt bank.
Alex (AE): owners and next steps: Maya -> prompt bank & evals; Kyle -> infra plan + cost estimate; Jordan -> sec questionnaire; Sam -> SE schedule + customer comms; Alex -> pricing guardrails and exec sync. Can everyone ack? :white_check_mark:
Kyle (Eng): ack, will post cost estimate in the thread by tomorrow.
Jordan (Security): ack, will start questionnaire and ping for data flow.
Maya (SE): ack, will push prompt set to drive and link here.
Sam (SE-TPM): ack, I'll confirm customer's deployment preference and sample data timeline.
deploy-bot: New runbook page created: https://confluence.internal/redwood/pov/acme-runbook — draft added under "proof-of-value".
Alex (AE): perfect. I'll consolidate and send the PoV runbook draft to the customer after we have Jordan's sec notes and Kyle's estimate. Target: send by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (SE): quick note — include an eval rubric column for cost per 1k tokens so customer sees tradeoffs.
Alex (AE): good call. Ending thread for now — we'll reconvene after the attachments land. :thumbsup:
